moves.label: Temple Guard Jab
moves.description: Fast straight jab that checks movement without overcommitting.

moves.label: Low Sand Sweep
moves.description: Low sliding sweep that clips stand guard and leaves Nam crouched.

moves.label: Desert Palm Check
moves.description: Compact mid palm for close-range confirms.

moves.label: Cross Step Roundhouse

jabright.label: Desert Palm Check
jabright.description: Mid palm check that links from jab and keeps Nam stable.

kickleft.label: Low Sand Sweep
kickleft.description: Low sliding sweep that threatens stand block but is punishable.

kickright.label: Cross Step Roundhouse
kickright.description: Committed mid roundhouse that carries Nam forward for combo enders.

cmd:f+1.label: Pilgrim Step Palm
cmd:f+1.description: Advancing palm that reaches farther than Nam's standing checks.

cmd:d/f+2.label: Desert Rising Palm
cmd:d/f+2.description: Unsafe rising palm that launches when Nam reads a grounded approach.

cmd:qcf+4.label: Desert Gale Roundhouse
cmd:qcf+4.description: Spinning roundhouse with enough lift to stabilize juggle routes.

cmd:WS+4.label: Rising Turban Kick
cmd:WS+4.description: While-standing kick that catches opponents after crouch pressure.

cmd:FC+1.label: Crouching Prayer Palm
cmd:FC+1.description: Quick crouching palm for interrupting after a blocked low.

cmd:FC+2.label: Low Well Launcher
cmd:FC+2.description: Crouch-starting launcher with real reward and real block risk.

cmd:1+2.label: Prayer Palm Barrage
cmd:1+2.description: Two-palm rush that keeps Nam close when it lands.

cmd:1+3.label: Heaven Cross Lift
cmd:1+3.description: Leaping cross-arm starter that launches but leaves Nam open on block.

cmd:2+3.label: Pilgrim Low Feint
cmd:2+3.description: Low feint that slips under highs and returns Nam to crouch.

cmd:2+4.label: Sliding Sand Sweep
cmd:2+4.description: Long low sweep that knocks down when Nam commits to the slide.

cmd:3+4.label: Cross-Arm Dive
cmd:3+4.description: Signature aerial dive that cashes out juggle routes with a hard knockdown.

cmd:O+2.label: Heaven Cross Strike
cmd:O+2.description: Ki-spending cross-arm finisher with strong carry and no projectile follow-up.
